items.text:
うんこをすすぐと、手が汚れてしまいました。
Study point: The grammar pattern 〜と、Xすることができる means 'to be able to do something by doing something else', emphasizing the ability to do something as a result of doing another thing.
English translation: I got dirty by washing the poop.
